articles.title: Yamato Holdings (TSE:9064) Stock Could Trade At A Discount To Fair Value
articles.summary: Yamato Holdings shares have moved sharply in the past week, which naturally puts the spotlight on whether the current market price lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. Investors now have to ask if recent share gains are being matched by the value suggested by a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view of Yamato Holdings' future cash flows. articles.title: Why Yamato Holdings (TSE:9064) Is Back In The Spotlight
articles.summary: Yamato Holdings (TSE:9064) has come back into focus after recent trading saw the stock close at ¥2,020, leaving it down about 10% year to date but higher over the past 3 months. Recent trading has been more supportive, with Yamato Holdings posting a 1-day share price return of 0.9% and an 11.02% share price return over 90 days.
